{
 "command": "cat > programs/task-7ad04219.py <<'PY'
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [x for row in grid for x in row]
    bg = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Full-width / full-height solid lines are the separators between panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]

    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            count = sum(
                grid[r][c] != bg
                for r in range(row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1])
                for c in range(col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1])
            )
            row.append(1 if count > 1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
